verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα χωρισθεὶς ἐκ τῶν Ἀθηνῶν ἦλθεν εἰς Κόρινθον
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta chōristheis ek tōn Athēnōn ēlthen eis Korinthon
verses.literal: After this [Paul] left . . . - Athens [and] went to Corinth

verses.original: καὶ εὑρών τινα Ἰουδαῖον ὀνόματι Ἀκύλαν τῷ γένει Ποντικὸν προσφάτως ἐληλυθότα ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰταλίας καὶ αὐτοῦ γυναῖκα Πρίσκιλλαν διὰ Κλαύδιον τὸ διατεταχέναι πάντας τοὺς Ἰουδαίους χωρίζεσθαι ἀπὸ τῆς Ῥώμης προσῆλθεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai heurōn tina Ioudaion onomati Akylan tō genei Pontikon prosphatōs elēlythota apo tēs Italias kai autou gynaika Priskillan dia Klaudion to diatetachenai pantas tous Ioudaious chōrizesthai apo tēs Rhōmēs prosēlthen autois
verses.literal: [There] he found a Jew named Aquila - a native of Pontus who {had} recently come from - Italy with his wife Priscilla because Claudius - had ordered all the Jews to leave . . . - Rome [Paul] went to [ visit ] them

verses.original: καὶ ἔμενεν καὶ ἠργάζετο παρ’ αὐτοῖς διὰ γὰρ ἦσαν σκηνοποιοὶ τῇ τέχνῃ τὸ ὁμότεχνον εἶναι
verses.transliteration: kai emenen kai ērgazeto par’ autois dia gar ēsan skēnopoioi tē technē to homotechnon einai
verses.literal: and he stayed and worked with them because - they were tentmakers vvv by trade - [just as] he was

verses.original: κατὰ πᾶν σάββατον δὲ Διελέγετο ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἔπειθέν Ἰουδαίους καὶ Ἕλληνας τε
verses.transliteration: kata pan sabbaton de Dielegeto en tē synagōgē epeithen Ioudaious kai Hellēnas te
verses.literal: - Every Sabbath - he reasoned in the synagogue trying to persuade Jews and Greeks alike

verses.original: δὲ Ὡς τε ὅ Σιλᾶς καὶ ὁ Τιμόθεος κατῆλθον ἀπὸ τῆς Μακεδονίας ὁ Παῦλος συνείχετο τῷ λόγῳ διαμαρτυρόμενος τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις Ἰησοῦν εἶναι τὸν Χριστὸν
verses.transliteration: de Hōs te ho Silas kai ho Timotheos katēlthon apo tēs Makedonias ho Paulos syneicheto tō logō diamartyromenos tois Ioudaiois Iēsoun einai ton Christon
verses.literal: And when - - Silas and - Timothy came down from - Macedonia - Paul devoted himself fully to the word testifying to the Jews [that] Jesus is the Christ

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν ἀντιτασσομένων καὶ βλασφημούντων ἐκτιναξάμενος τὰ ἱμάτια εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ὑμῶν Τὸ αἷμα ἐπὶ ὑμῶν τὴν κεφαλὴν ἐγώ καθαρὸς ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν πορεύσομαι εἰς τὰ ἔθνη
verses.transliteration: de autōn antitassomenōn kai blasphēmountōn ektinaxamenos ta himatia eipen pros autous hymōn To haima epi hymōn tēn kephalēn egō katharos apo tou nyn poreusomai eis ta ethnē
verses.literal: But [when] they opposed and insulted [him] he shook out [his] garments [and] told . . . them Your - blood [be] on your [own] heads I [am] innocent [of it] From - now on I will go to the Gentiles

verses.original: Καὶ μεταβὰς ἐκεῖθεν τῇ συναγωγῇ εἰσῆλθεν ἦν συνομοροῦσα εἰς οἰκίαν τινὸς ὀνόματι Τίτου Ἰούστου οὗ ἡ οἰκία σεβομένου τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Kai metabas ekeithen tē synagōgē eisēlthen ēn synomorousa eis oikian tinos onomati Titou Ioustou hou hē oikia sebomenou ton Theon
verses.literal: [So] [Paul] left . . . the synagogue [and] went - next door to [the] house of - Titus Justus - - - a worshiper - of God

verses.original: δὲ Κρίσπος ὁ ἀρχισυνάγωγος σὺν αὐτοῦ ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ ἐπίστευσεν τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ πολλοὶ τῶν Κορινθίων ἀκούοντες ἐπίστευον καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο
verses.transliteration: de Krispos ho archisynagōgos syn autou holō tō oikō episteusen tō Kyriō kai polloi tōn Korinthiōn akouontes episteuon kai ebaptizonto
verses.literal: - Crispus the synagogue leader and his whole - household believed in the Lord And many of the Corinthians who heard [ the message ] believed and were baptized

verses.original: δὲ ἐν νυκτὶ ὁ Κύριος Εἶπεν τῷ Παύλῳ δι’ ὁράματος Μὴ φοβοῦ ἀλλὰ λάλει καὶ μὴ σιωπήσῃς
verses.transliteration: de en nykti ho Kyrios Eipen tō Paulō di’ horamatos Mē phobou alla lalei kai mē siōpēsēs
verses.literal: One . . . night the Lord spoke - to Paul in a vision {Do} not be afraid - keep on speaking - {do} not be silent

verses.original: διότι ἐγώ εἰμι μετὰ σοῦ καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπιθήσεταί σοι τοῦ κακῶσαί σε διότι ἐστί μοι πολὺς λαός ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ πόλει
verses.transliteration: dioti egō eimi meta sou kai oudeis epithēsetai soi tou kakōsai se dioti esti moi polys laos en tautē tē polei
verses.literal: For I am with you and no one will lay a hand on . . . . . . . . . you because I have . . . many people in this - city

verses.original: δὲ Ἐκάθισεν ἐνιαυτὸν καὶ ἓξ μῆνας διδάσκων τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de Ekathisen eniauton kai hex mēnas didaskōn ton logon tou Theou en autois
verses.literal: [So] [Paul] stayed for a year and [a half] . . . teaching the word - of God among [the Corinthians]

verses.original: δὲ Γαλλίωνος ὄντος ἀνθυπάτου τῆς Ἀχαΐας οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ὁμοθυμαδὸν κατεπέστησαν τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ βῆμα
verses.transliteration: de Galliōnos ontos anthypatou tēs Achaias hoi Ioudaioi homothymadon katepestēsan tō Paulō kai ēgagon auton epi to bēma
verses.literal: [While] Gallio was proconsul of Achaia the Jews coordinated an attack - on Paul and brought him before the judgment seat

verses.original: οὗτος ἀναπείθει τοὺς ἀνθρώπους σέβεσθαι τὸν Θεόν Παρὰ τὸν νόμον λέγοντες ὅτι
verses.transliteration: houtos anapeithei tous anthrōpous sebesthai ton Theon Para ton nomon legontes hoti
verses.literal: This [man] is persuading the [people] to worship - God in ways contrary to the law they said -

verses.original: δὲ τοῦ Παύλου Μέλλοντος ἀνοίγειν τὸ στόμα ὁ Γαλλίων εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς Ἰουδαίους Εἰ μὲν ἦν τι ἀδίκημά ἢ πονηρόν ῥᾳδιούργημα ὦ Ἰουδαῖοι κατὰ λόγον ἂν ἀνεσχόμην ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: de tou Paulou Mellontos anoigein to stoma ho Galliōn eipen pros tous Ioudaious Ei men ēn ti adikēma ē ponēron rhadiourgēma ō Ioudaioi kata logon an aneschomēn hymōn
verses.literal: But [just as] - Paul was about to speak . . . . . . - Gallio told . . . the Jews If - this matter involved a wrongdoing or vicious crime O Jews vvv it would be reasonable vvv for me to hear your [ complaint ]

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ἐστιν ζητήματά περὶ λόγου καὶ ὀνομάτων καὶ τοῦ καθ’ ὑμᾶς νόμου ὄψεσθε αὐτοί ἐγὼ βούλομαι οὐ εἶναι κριτὴς τούτων
verses.transliteration: de ei estin zētēmata peri logou kai onomatōn kai tou kath’ hymas nomou opsesthe autoi egō boulomai ou einai kritēs toutōn
verses.literal: But since it is a dispute about words and names and vvv vvv your own law settle [it] yourselves I refuse . . . to be a judge of such things

verses.original: καὶ ἀπήλασεν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ βήματος
verses.transliteration: kai apēlasen autous apo tou bēmatos
verses.literal: And he drove them {away} from the judgment seat

verses.original: δὲ πάντες Ἐπιλαβόμενοι Σωσθένην τὸν ἀρχισυνάγωγον ἔτυπτον ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ βήματος καὶ οὐδὲν τούτων ἔμελεν τῷ Γαλλίωνι
verses.transliteration: de pantes Epilabomenoi Sōsthenēn ton archisynagōgon etypton emprosthen tou bēmatos kai ouden toutōn emelen tō Galliōni
verses.literal: At this the crowd seized Sosthenes the synagogue leader [and] beat [him] in front of the judgment seat [But] none of this was of concern - to Gallio

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Παῦλος προσμείνας ἱκανὰς ἔτι ἡμέρας ἀποταξάμενος τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς τὴν κεφαλήν κειράμενος ἐν Κενχρεαῖς γὰρ εὐχήν εἶχεν ἐξέπλει εἰς τὴν Συρίαν καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ Πρίσκιλλα καὶ Ἀκύλας
verses.transliteration: de Ho Paulos prosmeinas hikanas eti hēmeras apotaxamenos tois adelphois tēn kephalēn keiramenos en Kenchreais gar euchēn eichen exeplei eis tēn Syrian kai syn autō Priskilla kai Akylas
verses.literal: - - Paul remained [in Corinth] for quite some time [before] saying goodbye to the brothers {He had} [his] head shaved in Cenchrea to keep a vow he had [ made ] [and then] he sailed for - Syria vvv accompanied by - Priscilla and Aquila

verses.original: δὲ Κατήντησαν εἰς Ἔφεσον κατέλιπεν αὐτοῦ κἀκείνους δὲ αὐτὸς εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν διελέξατο τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις
verses.transliteration: de Katēntēsan eis Epheson katelipen autou kakeinous de autos eiselthōn eis tēn synagōgēn dielexato tois Ioudaiois
verses.literal: [When] they reached . . . Ephesus [Paul] left . . . [Priscilla and Aquila] - He himself went into the synagogue [there] [and] reasoned with the Jews

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν ἐρωτώντων μεῖναι ἐπὶ πλείονα χρόνον οὐκ ἐπένευσεν
verses.transliteration: de autōn erōtōntōn meinai epi pleiona chronon ouk epeneusen
verses.literal: [When] they asked [him] to stay for a while longer . . . vvv he declined

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἀποταξάμενος καὶ εἰπών Πάλιν ἀνακάμψω πρὸς ὑμᾶς τοῦ Θεοῦ θέλοντος ἀνήχθη ἀπὸ τῆς Ἐφέσου
verses.transliteration: alla apotaxamenos kai eipōn Palin anakampsō pros hymas tou Theou thelontos anēchthē apo tēs Ephesou
verses.literal: But as he left - he said vvv I will come back to you - [if] God is willing [And] he set sail from - Ephesus

verses.original: καὶ κατελθὼν εἰς Καισάρειαν ἀναβὰς καὶ ἀσπασάμενος τὴν ἐκκλησίαν κατέβη εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν
verses.transliteration: kai katelthōn eis Kaisareian anabas kai aspasamenos tēn ekklēsian katebē eis Antiocheian
verses.literal: [When Paul] had landed at Caesarea he went up and greeted the church [ at Jerusalem ] [Then] he went down to Antioch

verses.original: Καὶ ποιήσας τινὰ χρόνον ἐξῆλθεν καθεξῆς διερχόμενος τὴν χώραν Γαλατικὴν καὶ Φρυγίαν στηρίζων πάντας τοὺς μαθητάς
verses.transliteration: Kai poiēsas tina chronon exēlthen kathexēs dierchomenos tēn chōran Galatikēn kai Phrygian stērizōn pantas tous mathētas
verses.literal: [After] [Paul] had spent some time [in Antioch] he traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia strengthening all the disciples

verses.original: δέ τις Ἰουδαῖος ὀνόματι Ἀπολλῶς τῷ γένει Ἀλεξανδρεὺς κατήντησεν εἰς Ἔφεσον ὢν λόγιος ἀνὴρ δυνατὸς ἐν ταῖς γραφαῖς
verses.transliteration: de tis Ioudaios onomati Apollōs tō genei Alexandreus katēntēsen eis Epheson ōn logios anēr dynatos en tais graphais
verses.literal: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos - a native of Alexandria came to Ephesus He was an eloquent man well versed in the Scriptures

verses.original: οὗτος ἦν κατηχημένος τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ ζέων τῷ πνεύματι ἐλάλει καὶ ἐδίδασκεν ἀκριβῶς τὰ περὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐπιστάμενος μόνον τὸ βάπτισμα Ἰωάννου
verses.transliteration: houtos ēn katēchēmenos tēn hodon tou Kyriou kai zeōn tō pneumati elalei kai edidasken akribōs ta peri tou Iēsou epistamenos monon to baptisma Iōannou
verses.literal: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord and was fervent - in spirit He spoke and taught accurately - about - Jesus [though] he knew only the baptism of John

verses.original: τε οὗτός ἤρξατο παρρησιάζεσθαι ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ δὲ Πρίσκιλλα καὶ Ἀκύλας ἀκούσαντες αὐτοῦ προσελάβοντο αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξέθεντο αὐτῷ τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀκριβέστερον
verses.transliteration: te houtos ērxato parrēsiazesthai en tē synagōgē de Priskilla kai Akylas akousantes autou proselabonto auton kai exethento autō tēn hodon tou Theou akribesteron
verses.literal: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue [When] Priscilla and Aquila heard him they took him aside . . . and explained to him the way of God more accurately

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ Βουλομένου διελθεῖν εἰς τὴν Ἀχαΐαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ προτρεψάμενοι ἔγραψαν τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἀποδέξασθαι αὐτόν παραγενόμενος ὃς πολὺ συνεβάλετο τοῖς διὰ τῆς χάριτος πεπιστευκόσιν
verses.transliteration: de autou Boulomenou dielthein eis tēn Achaian hoi adelphoi protrepsamenoi egrapsan tois mathētais apodexasthai auton paragenomenos hos poly synebaleto tois dia tēs charitos pepisteukosin
verses.literal: [When] [Apollos] resolved to cross over to - Achaia the brothers encouraged [him] [and] wrote to the disciples [there] to welcome him On his arrival . . . he {was a} great help to those who by - grace had believed

verses.original: γὰρ εὐτόνως διακατηλέγχετο τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις δημοσίᾳ ἐπιδεικνὺς διὰ τῶν γραφῶν Ἰησοῦν εἶναι τὸν Χριστὸν
verses.transliteration: gar eutonōs diakatēlencheto tois Ioudaiois dēmosia epideiknys dia tōn graphōn Iēsoun einai ton Christon
verses.literal: For he powerfully refuted the Jews in public [debate] proving from the Scriptures [that] Jesus is the Christ
